comment.body:
Thanks for providing the 0.100.2 crash trace and diagnostic text. The `UWPApplication.Launch` NullReferenceException in this report matches the packaged-application launch failure already tracked in #49528, which remains open as the canonical investigation.

Please add the following to [#49528](https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/49528) so the newer occurrence can be included there:

1. The name of the packaged application, the search query, and the exact action that caused the crash, with the expected and actual results.
2. If possible, reproduce the crash again and submit a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the complete diagnostic ZIP is attached.

This issue can then be closed or consolidated as a duplicate of #49528 rather than tracking a parallel investigation.
